items.text: Changed: how a line runs is named like a clip's play mode in Resolume Arena: **Loop** (the default, as before) and **Bounce** (out and back, like a tide). Same behaviour, new names. More modes (random, play once and stop, play once and hold) are being worked out.

Changed: **The dice** is now two sections, from his drawing: **The dice** (chance: preset, favourite holds, repeat the step before, what a new roll keeps) and **The grid** (the foundation: scale, root note, tuning, sizes, size, default grid), with a grid icon. Saved section order and pins keep their places.
Fixed: pinching with two fingers no longer zooms the page and scales the index.

Changed: the lines section is now in two groups, from his drawing: **How they play** (line-up, the lines, feel, tempo and **When they meet**) and **How they look** (notes show as, how long a sound lasts, the field, grid space). When they meet moved up into the play group.
Changed: **Motion on** for the crossfader now starts as **Breath** (a gentle swing every 2 bars), so you see it move straight away. Pick another preset or change the settings as before.

Fixed: the crossfader's **Motion on** no longer looks like it waits for a preset. Motion on follows the settings below it; when those settings equal a preset (Tide, Breath, Slow Seesaw, Phrase, Section, Rise) that preset lights up by itself, and when you change them it goes back to unlit while motion stays on. (It was moving all along, but Tide takes two minutes a cycle, so it looked stuck with nothing selected.)

the **equalizer stays in full screen**. When the controls fade away, faint bars play under the grid, one per column, moving with the sound. Touch the screen and the controls come back (the bars go). The eye (clean) screen keeps its hold-to-exit bars rising to the line.

a setting, **Full screen exit bars**, in the heads-up display under Performance: **Equalizer** or **Plain bar**. Plain bar shows nothing while idle, and one straight bar that rises to the exit line when you hold.
Changed: the button next to the dice is now the **line-up button**. Its picture is the current line-up; tap it to choose another (it opens the same two-column menu; tap again to close it).

Changed: **holding the robot** now opens the heads-up display at its settings (tempo, how many lines, what happens when it stops). Tapping it still starts and stops it. The line-up menu moved to the new button.
Changed: **Swell** has a new picture, a crashing wave. It works as before: press and it swells, let go and it eases back.
Freeze is **in detention**: its pad is gone from the bar. The feature is kept: key F, and holding an empty cell in the hold hand, still freeze.

Removed: the **Ripple** and **Drain** line-ups, and "Ring widening" and "Ring closing" from the Way menus. Since the grid became rectangular they swept the same square rings as **Grow** and **Shrink**. Orbit, Breath and Whirl now use Grow and Shrink, and a saved look, piece or custom line-up that used the ring ways opens on Grow and Shrink.
icons for the **Shoreline** and **Two tides** line-ups. Breath's icon shows a square instead of a ring.

Fixed: in the line-ups menu (hold the play button) and the heads-up display, a line-up you had used a few times lost its name when Words is set to Learn, which left a blank yellow pill when it was chosen. Line-up names now always show.
